verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no run-history view for inspecting past flow executions and no user-triggered retry of a failed run from its failing step. The only related item is durable execution, where infrastructure-interrupted runs resume automatically from a checkpoint. That is an adjacent reliability mechanism, not an ops user re-running a failed execution. Agent audit logs are also adjacent and are not flow execution logs.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can inspect past execution logs and re-run a failed execution, resuming from the failing step
